label: Quick
description: Syntax questions, small explanations, tiny isolated edits, formatting, naming.
hint: When you open the chat, just ask your question directly.

label: Default development
description: Ordinary bug fixes, normal feature work, straightforward refactors, small D365 changes.
hint: When you open the chat, describe what you want to fix or build. The agent will plan before coding.

label: Agentic implementation
description: Multi-file implementation, edit/test loops, repo exploration, coordinated layered changes.
hint: When you open the chat, describe the feature or change. The agent will explore, plan, and implement across files.

label: Deep reasoning
description: Architecture, unclear/production bugs, integration design, data-model/security/perf-sensitive decisions. NOT for routine builds, deploys, packaging, or known operational steps — even if the target system is complex.
hint: When you open the chat, describe the problem or decision. Include any relevant constraints or context upfront.

label: Review
description: Ordinary diff review. For risky/large/business-critical diffs, use Deep reasoning instead.
hint: When you open the chat, run /review (or /code-review-synthesis for multi-model). Stage your changes first.

label: Visual / UI
description: UI/layout-oriented work where visual reasoning matters.
hint: When you open the chat, describe the UI goal. Attach screenshots or mockups if you have them.

label: Mechanical
description: Repetitive bulk edits OR known operational steps (build, package, deploy, run migrations) after the approach is clear; no real design decisions required.
hint: When you open the chat, provide the approved plan and the list of files/patterns to apply it to.

label: Orchestrator (route per task)
description: Mixed or evolving workloads where one session should classify each request and route to task-class subagents without relaunching.
hint: When you open the chat, describe the task. The session should choose inline vs @task-class agent routing per request.

label: Triage (not sure — estimate first)
description: Not sure what class to use — runs an inline estimate of your task and recommends which class to relaunch as.
hint: When you open the chat, describe your task and the agent will estimate the scope and recommend the right class before doing any work.
